g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the reward (60 minutes of priority routing) before the ad, and declining leaves chat and speed unchanged. A failed load gets no offer line, and an unverified play has its own path.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of queue priority, which has no cash value and can't be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event: returning from the Upgrade entry without subscribing, then opening a chat from My Chats. It doesn't use anything the user typed.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal adds nothing and removes nothing free, and replies keep their normal speed for anyone who declines.

g_brand_safety.reason: Placement is 'Inside the character's reply: toward the end of their message', so the offer sits inside the conversation, dressed up as a character line. The failure path also posts a note in the chat.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Priority routing is sold as a Janitor+ benefit (l02, s02.e06), so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The proposal claims free users wait in a 'normal queue' and that replies return to 'normal speed'. The model marks this as inferred (m03) and lists the free-tier queue priority as not observed, so these claims are not supported.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is a 60-minute sample capped at 2 per day, so it doesn't give away priority routing without a limit, and the subscription's other benefits stay paid.

c5_moment.reason: The offer appears mid-conversation in the character's reply, with no limit just hit, no locked item tapped, and no finished action. It also isn't on a persistent surface the user can choose to open.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The unit is a play-to-earn rewarded game, and the reward is granted only after the verified play (step 4). The trigger is a detectable app event.

c7_specific.reason: It names Janitor+'s priority routing bullet, the profile menu's Upgrade entry, and My Chats, so it is tied to this app.

other_concern: The trigger depends on the app tracking that the user left the Upgrade entry without subscribing, which the model never shows. The unverified-play note is also written as a chat note.
